targets.queryText:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    bidirectional_bytes,
    risk,
    json_extract(enrichment, '$.geoip.country')      AS country,
    json_extract(enrichment, '$.geoip.country_name') AS country_name
  FROM network_dpi
  WHERE 
  (
    src_ip IN (${client_ip:singlequote})
    OR
    dst_ip IN (${client_ip:singlequote})
  )
  AND 
  (
    '__ALL__' IN (${country_name:singlequote})
    OR
    json_extract(enrichment, '$.geoip.country_name') IN (${country_name:singlequote})
  )
  AND
  (
    '__ALL__' IN (${application_name:singlequote}) 
    OR 
    application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote})
  )
  AND risk IN (${risk:raw})
  AND timestamp >= $__from / 1000 AND timestamp < $__to / 1000
),
geo AS (
  SELECT * FROM filtered WHERE length(country_name) > 0
)
SELECT
  country,
  country_name,
  100.0 * SUM(bidirectional_bytes) / (SELECT SUM(bidirectional_bytes) FROM geo) AS "% of bytes"
FROM geo
GROUP BY country, country_name
ORDER BY "% of bytes" DESC

panels.description: Flow count and I/O is visualised by server names.

targets.queryText:
WITH dpi AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN requested_server_name IS NULL OR requested_server_name = '' OR requested_server_name = 'unknown'
         THEN 'unknown' ELSE requested_server_name END AS host,
    bidirectional_bytes AS io,
    risk
  FROM network_dpi
  WHERE 
  (
    src_ip IN (${client_ip:singlequote})
    OR
    dst_ip IN (${client_ip:singlequote})
  )
  AND 
  (
    '__ALL__' IN (${country_name:singlequote})
    OR
    json_extract(enrichment, '$.geoip.country_name') IN (${country_name:singlequote})
  )
  AND
  (
    '__ALL__' IN (${application_name:singlequote}) 
    OR 
    application_name IN (${application_name:singlequote})
  )
  AND risk IN (${risk:raw})
  AND timestamp >= $__from / 1000 AND timestamp < $__to / 1000
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN t.last_dot = 0 THEN t.host
       ELSE substr(t.host, t.second_last_dot + 1)
  END AS "Domain",
  COUNT(*)                                        AS "Flows",
  SUM(t.io)                                       AS "I/O",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.risk > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS "Risky Flow Counts"
FROM (
  SELECT
    host, io, risk,
    length(rtrim(host, replace(host, '.', ''))) AS last_dot,
    length(rtrim(
      substr(host, 1, length(rtrim(host, replace(host, '.', ''))) - 1),
      replace(substr(host, 1, length(rtrim(host, replace(host, '.', ''))) - 1), '.', ''))) AS second_last_dot
  FROM dpi
) t
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Flows" DESC
LIMIT 10
